customManagers.description: uv's required-version floor in api/pyproject.toml is also the exact uv CI installs

packageRules.description: Default: chore(deps) so tooling bumps (devDependencies, GitHub Actions, pre-commit hook revs, Docker base digests, docs-site) don't cut a release
One weekly PR for all non-major tooling bumps instead of one PR per package; majors stay separate PRs
Linters and formatters add rules in minor releases; their own PR keeps a new finding from blocking every other tooling bump
astro-mermaid peers on mermaid's major: bump them together or npm can't resolve the lock file
Green non-major and digest bumps merge themselves (rebase, per repo convention). Runtime deps and majors opt back out below / by update type
docker-compose.yml is what self-hosters run: a digest pin would freeze them on one :latest image
uv in CI/dev (api/pyproject.toml floor) and in the Dockerfile move together, after the docker images rule so this group wins
Runtime web deps change what ships: fix(deps) cuts a release
Runtime API deps ([project.dependencies]) change what ships: fix(deps)

uvicorn (selfhost group) ships in the release image; dependency-groups can't be told apart by depType, so match by name. The aws group (boto3, mangum) stays chore: releases ship only the selfhost image, and Lambda deploys don't use releases
Weekly lock file refresh is maintenance: chore(deps). It is also the only thing that moves transitive deps (e.g. certifi in uv.lock), so it merges itself once green rather than waiting for a review
